title: Object Remover: AI Video Object Remover Online
excerpt: Remove unwanted people, logos, text and objects from videos or images with Object Remover, an AI video object remover that works online in minutes.
content_html:
AI video object remover

Object Remover for Video and Images

Remove unwanted people, logos, text, watermarks and other distractions online. Our AI video object remover tracks the target across every frame and rebuilds the background automatically.

● MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG · No desktop app needed

Video firstTrack through every frame

One promptDescribe the unwanted object

Clean exportKeep original audio intact

Mark the target once. The AI tracks every frame.

Drag the slider on the clip to see the tracking mask. Mark the players once and Object Remover follows each of them through the whole video, then uses that same mask to restore the background and export a clean cut.

Frame-locked tracking

Moving targets stay locked, frame after frame.

The green overlay is the live tracking mask. Mark a player, a logo or a passer-by once and the video object remover keeps it locked through motion, turns and camera pans — no frame-by-frame masking.

Prompt or brush

Type “the players” or brush over a target on a clear frame — the object remover builds the tracking mask from there.

One object remover for video and images

The same online AI tool cleans a photo, a short clip or a full video — tracking takes over whenever the target moves.

How to use the video object remover

Upload your media, select the unwanted object and export a clean result in three simple steps.

01 /

Drop in a clip

Upload an MP4 or MOV. Photos work too when the job starts with a still.

02 /

Name the distraction

Use a natural-language prompt or brush a loose mask over the target on a clear frame.

03 /

Export the clean cut

Review the result, fine-tune the mask if needed, then download a ready-to-use file.

See the Object Remover result in motion

A BMX rider crosses the frame. Drag the slider to wipe between the original footage and the AI-cleaned clip; the smaller panel shows the tracking mask the object remover used to rebuild the background behind him.

Tracking mask

What the AI saw

The green overlay marks every pixel the tracker locked onto the rider. The inpainting model rebuilds only those pixels, so the rest of the frame stays untouched.
